newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee regions to see warm week - Somar.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee regions to see warm week - Somar.

text.p: Brazil's coffee regions should see warm weather over the coming five days with no damaging cold in sight, local meteorologists Somar said Sunday.
Minimum temperatures over the weekend were between 11 and 16 degrees Celsius and were expected to remain high throughout the week, said Somar forecaster Marcos Massari.
After a period of unusually wet weather, isolated showers were only forecast on June 24-25 in the south of Minas Gerais state, he added.
The forecast will come as welcome news to producers who have seen early hopes of a good quality harvest dashed by the recent rains which have disrupted the harvest and hit quality.

The next cold front is expected in the Pacific Ocean on June 27, but it is too early to say what impact it may have for coffee regions, Massari said. ((-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
